product_metadata.title: LIFVER Salad Bowls, 20 Oz Soup Bowls,Ceramic Bowls for kictchen, White Bowls for soup cereal rice noodle, Set of 4, Dishwasher & Microwave Safe
features: Deep Versatile Bowls: 28 oz, 7"*7"1.9", deep versatile bowls can be used as soup bowls, salad bowls, serving bowls, cereal bowls, ramen bowls, pho bowls, noodle bowls. Large bolws for kitchen to meet your daily use.

Wide Opening Design: Even large size food can be easily put in and stir, never worrying about the soup ramen noodle pho spilling. Also deep mouth serving bowls are more conducive to heat dissipation of the food, to cool the food quickly.

Easy to use: Salad bowls are so light to hold even for kids. It can be stacked to save cabinet space. The edge of the wide opening is the best design for holding, never worry burned by hot ceramic bowls.

Durability and Safety: Salad bowls made of top-grade ceramic, lead-free and cadmium-free.Smooth glaze, easy to clean, dishwasher safe microwave safe. Super sturdy and durable soup bowls, you deserve it!
Classic White Color: Pure white bowls never goes out of style. Classic bright white bowls match most existing dinnerware.
